purpose: Teach: 砂利/空き地/ニキビ/小指/左下/レディース/インナー/レザー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが砂利道を毎日歩かれた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he walked that gravel road every day, didn't he.
lines.style: Soft, faraway quality. Speaking as if looking into a memory. Gentle rhythm. The voice of someone who has held this image for decades.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、空き地に家庭菜園を開かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and your father opened a little vegetable garden in that empty lot, remember, dear?
lines.style: Warm, almost teasing. A gentle correction wrapped in affection. Eyes bright. She's bringing something back to him across time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんはニキビが治る薬草に詳しかった
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he knew all about the herbs that cleared up skin. The remedies.
lines.style: Quiet insistence. Like he's correcting the record gently. Slight pause before the explanation—making sure she understands which memory he means.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、小指に古い指輪をされてたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your father wore an old ring on his pinky back then, didn't he, dear? I remember that.
lines.style: Soft smile in the voice. She's testing him, affirming something he might have forgotten. Indulgent. A small conspiratorial warmth.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが新聞の左下の論評を読まれた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he always read the editorial section in the bottom left of the newspaper.
lines.style: Deliberate, specific. Each detail placed like a stone in still water. The weight of a small, ordinary habit made tender by time.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、私のためにレディース服を選んで下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your father chose all my dresses for me, you know. He had such a good eye, dear.
lines.style: Grateful, almost surprised. As if she's still marveling at this kindness. A slight lift at 'eye'—pleasure in the memory of being cared for so thoughtfully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがインナーシャツを愛用された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he favored a certain kind of undershirt. Wore them all the time.
lines.style: Patient recitation. The voice of someone preserving small facts against forgetting. Steady, unhurried. A kind of devotion in the precision.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、レザーの旅行鞄を大事にされてたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your father took such care of that leather travel bag of his. Kept it all these years, dear.
lines.style: Warm, closing inward. A final memory, held close. Slight trailing-off at the end, as if she's turning away gently from the weight of it all.
